schema.name: map_view
schema.description: Read the project map, core, pending notes, and stale flags. Follow nextPendingAfter as pending_after and nextGroupAfter as group_after even after edits. For a group with omittedNotes, read group_id with note_after from nextNoteAfter until complete. Group pages omit pending notes.

root_session_id.description: Map owner Session id; omit for your own conversation, specify for another map you curate.

pending_after.description: Continue pending notes after this id; use nextPendingAfter.

group_after.description: Continue groups after this id; use nextGroupAfter, or an empty string to start groups only.

group_id.description: Read one group and its notes without pending notes.

note_after.description: Continue group_id notes after this id; use nextNoteAfter.
